GIMP cannot convert images to CMYK mode. GIMP is fundamentally an RGB-based image editor and does not have native CMYK color mode support. After exploring the Image menu options (Mode, Color Management, and Image Properties), no CMYK conversion capability was found.

To convert your image to CMYK mode, you would need to use alternative software such as:
- Adobe Photoshop
- Affinity Photo
- GIMP with the Separate+ plugin (if installed)
- Online CMYK conversion tools
- Inkscape with appropriate color management settings
